rule.score: mean(force_RMS+.03*active_error_cm+cap_fraction)+.25*max(0,max(case_cost-initial_case_cost)); no ratio normalization at near-zero baselines
rule.severe: any physics boundary; active error >initial+max(20cm,.5*initial) or force>initial+2N; short08 root_max_displacement>initial+.10m; none root_max_displacement>initial+.10m
rule.rollback: restore exact best network+Adam; halve nominal actorLR; keep actual sampler state and collect fresh on-policy batch
rule.tie: strict score improvement only; initial always retained
